MultiPointCostGame: reachable states and minimax

All forward reachable states are shown in the position–velocity plane at each of the five decision times. The two highlighted paths show a minimizing fixed open-loop plan under its worst disturbance sequence and a causal policy under a locally worst-case disturbance.

Adaptation: the source RL task has checkpoint costs at t=1 and t=3 and a terminal cost at t=4. This pilot preserves its source Euler dynamics and terminal cost, but omits both checkpoint costs. It uses four one-second decisions and catalogues {−1, 0, 1} for control and disturbance. This is a finite terminal-only minimax comparison, not a reproduction of the RL training run. No target or backward winning set is defined.

Values: open-loop 177.485266; causal feedback 21.5124276. Solver-call observations after one warmup: open-loop: median 2042245 ns, range 1985114–2243809 ns; causal feedback: median 277552 ns, range 179843–483306 ns. They describe different information patterns and are not a speed comparison. Result JSON · Figure data · Capture environment · Standalone SVG
